text:
maria: Quick preflight — we're targeting the v2.1 model rollout Friday 09:00 PST. Can infra confirm H100 reservations in us-west1 + eu-west1? Need 4 H100s per region for a ~3h peak. Any quota limits we should pre-bake?

devin: On it. Current reserved pool shows 2 H100s in us-west1 (dedicated), eu-west1 has 0 reserved. We have spot capacity across both but not guaranteed for a hard reserve.

sam: Which GCP/AWS account is this under? if it's tenant-17-prod we need billing contact on the quota request — otherwise cloud won't expedite.

maria: tenant: tenant-17-prod. Billing contact: billing@acme.com. Need a hard reserve, not spot. If vendor can't guarantee, fallback = mixed H100+A500 burst plan.

jin: Vendor X told us new blades are due Fri morning but ETA is soft. Suggest two safeguards: 1) immediate quota bump request to cloud, 2) create a fallback canary config that uses 4x A500 + 2x H100 if H100 <4.

procure-bot: Procurement ticket created: PROC-7891. Status: pending vendor confirmation. Vendor ETA: "Fri 06:00-10:00 PST" (est). Assigned: procurement@redwood.com.

devin: I'll file the cloud quota ticket now. Draft payload: 
```
Request: increase GPU (H100) quota to 8 in us-west1 and 8 in eu-west1 for project redwood-prod.
Justification: scheduled model rollout v2.1, 3hr peak, reserved capacity required.
Contact: maria@redwood.com
```

sam: also adding a note to PROD runbook: alert on gpu.alloc.shortfall > 0.5 and automatic switch to fallback deployment.

maria: can someone ping our AM at Vendor X and cc procurement? Need an explicit "guaranteed allocation" confirmation in writing (manifest or email).

jin: pinged AM via DM and email. AM replied: "We can prioritize your racks; final confirmation after manifest at 05:00 PST." I'll forward the DM to procurement.

devin: Ticket submitted: CLOUD-5562. Internal link: https://go/issue/CLOUD-5562. Quota request id: 99823.

procure-bot: Vendor portal update: manifest generated. Allocations: us-west1 => 4 H100 assigned to tenant-17, eu-west1 => 2 H100 assigned. PROC-7891 updated with manifest.

maria: OK — new plan: if eu-west1 <4 by 07:00 PST we'll flip to fallback (A500 mix + quantized model). Devin / Sam / Jin please ack and confirm runbook steps.

devin: ack — I'll add the rollout job that switches instance group and validates kv-cache warmup.

sam: ack — updating runbook and adding alert runbook snippet now.

jin: ack — monitoring vendor portal and cloud quotas; will post final status by 07:15 PST :thumbsup:

maria: thanks all. If we get final confirmation from vendor, we'll push a short customer note about the scheduled maintenance window. :rocket:
